speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We will share more details on the revised approach when ready.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Tenants can continue to alert HDB to repair or maintenance issues.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I first want to acknowledge the wonderful support that is given to my division and our GRC as well, from the HDB Branch Office and the HQ rental division.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: On my house visits, though, even before COVID-19, I noticed that the preventive maintenance for issues, such as spalling concrete, peeling paint on the door gates and so on, I do not think the preventive maintenance happens annually or regularly.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: There could be a difference in perception leading to a lot of reactive kind of complaints for us at the Meet-the-People sessions by our residents.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: So, I wonder what the cause of this is.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: If, indeed, the constraint is resource or maybe such duties need to be outsourced, then could the resources be granted to the people on the ground?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Wherever we can, we will help as much as possible.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Perhaps, Mr Ang, if you could give way, I will call Parliamentary Question No 5.
